title: One slash command's answer
description: `POST /v1/agent/default/chat/commands/{command}:execute {revision, arguments, request_id}`. AGENT-NEW-1: an answer never carries a provider structure for a client to print. `display` is `{key, args}`: a sentence the App and Odomo word in the reader's language from scalar arguments (or lists of them); `result.summary` is the same sentence in plain English for a client that does not know the key. `native_request` asks the client to open its own thing: `choose_model` (the header's model picker; with `model`/`effort` when `/model <id> [effort]` named a valid choice, which then rides the next message, because codex has no stable model setter), `new_conversation` (the New conversation confirmation), `copy_last_response` / `export_conversation` (`text` goes to the clipboard). Refusals: `409 agent_command_unsupported` (the catalog's `reason_code` says why), `409 agent_busy`, `409 model_unavailable`, `409 reasoning_effort_unavailable`, `400 invalid_model_arguments`, `400 command_arguments_unsupported`, `400 command_argument_required`, `409 no_assistant_response`. AGENT-PLAN-1: `/plan` turns codex's Plan collaboration mode on (`plan.on`) or, when it is on, off (`plan.off`); `/plan <words>` turns it on and sends the words in the same turn (`plan.sent`, status `accepted`). `args.mode` is the mode it leaves the thread in; refusals add `409 agent_mode_unavailable` (a codex that will not change modes).
